instructions: In src/i18n.ts add one exported function: `trf(template: string, vars: Readonly<Record<string, string | number>> = {}): string`. It first translates the template with the existing `tr`, then replaces every `{name}` marker with the value of vars.name. Do the replacement in a single pass with one call to String.prototype.replace and a callback function, so that values are inserted literally (a value containing `$&` or `{other}` must not be interpreted). A marker whose name is not an own property of vars stays unchanged (check it with Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call). A value of 0 must be inserted as 0. Add a one-line Spanish doc comment like the one on `tr`. Do not change anything else in the file. You cannot run commands; after the edit, read the file once to confirm and finish.
